name: Article 17, after § 1 – 291/2
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the welfare of dogs and cats and their traceability
part_text: 1 a. From ... [5 years after the date of entry into force of this Regulation], all dogs kept by natural persons shall be individually identified in accordance with paragraph 1. From ... [10 years after the date of entry into force of this Regulation], all cats kept by natural persons shall be individually identified in accordance with paragraph 1.
